blockingFindings.finding: The note attaches both poor nourishment and diseases to accessible trash/human food. NPS L43-L44 directly supports accessible trash/human food and poor nourishment/shorter lives. L32 separately associates proximity to people/developed areas with greater risk of eating human food AND catching diseases from people/pets (and transmitting them). It does not say that discarded food/trash or eating it is the disease link. The current note collapses those distinct exposure routes into an unqualified association. This is insufficient primary grounding for that exact whole note; no assertion here that garbage can never carry pathogens.
